# developer.paypal.com documentation — Platforms — Reports

> 11 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Platforms under Reports. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Reports

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/sftp-access/): PayPal can deliver reports to a secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) environment, giving you automated access to detailed transaction data.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-reports-overview/): Use PayPal reports to monitor and reconcile business activity across one or more merchant accounts.
- [Access SFTP reports (/platforms/reports/sftp-access)](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/sftp-access.md): Learn how to access PayPal reports for partners through a secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) environment.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-merchant-reconciliation/balance-reconciliation-report): The Balance Reconciliation report helps merchants reconcile payment activity. It contains a list of all payments, disputes, and fee-incurring events.
- [partner-reports-overview.md](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-reports-overview.md): Reconcile daily payments and fees to account for all payment activity including sales, refunds, disputes, fees, and withdrawals. Understand payouts to your bank accounts.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-merchant-reconciliation/payouts-reconciliation): This report provides a detailed view of the activity on your platform and helps you with the reconciliation of end-to-end money flow and transactions.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-merchant-reconciliation/pricing-transaction): The Pricing Transaction report helps you reconcile transaction costs and analyze pricing trends across your platform.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-merchant-reconciliation/pricing-summary): This report provides a summary of transaction pricing and related costs.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-merchant-reconciliation/attempts-declines): The Attempts and Declines report offers comprehensive insights into payment transactions that were attempted and those that got declined for various reasons.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-merchant-reconciliation/marketplace-case-reconciliation): This report supports case management by providing details about cases that opened or closed on your platform during the reporting period.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/platforms/reports/partner-merchant-reconciliation/revenue-share-transactions): This report provides details about the revenue share that a partner earns from each transaction and the corresponding payout that settled to your PayPal or bank account.
